goal.answer: Replace the existing /join page with branching behaviour based on submission state: if the user already has an application in the new `applications` table, render a read-only summary view of what they submitted; otherwise show the multi-step wizard (step 1 multi-select dept picker, step 2 one RHF+Zod form per selected dept, final step POSTs via a Drizzle server action and shows confirmation). One application per user (UNIQUE on userId). Nav "Join MSC" button already routes to /join — no navbar change needed.

criteria.answer:
Replaced /join page branches on submission state: if a row exists for the current userId → render read-only "Your Application" summary card (lists chosen departments + each dept's submitted responses); if no row → render the multi-step wizard from scratch.
All 4 depts present and selectable: creativity, activity, engineering, media — with min 1 selected required (Zod-validated) in the wizard flow.
Each dept exposes its own Zod schema + placeholder form (≥2 fields each, e.g. name + why-join text), rendered via react-hook-form with @hookform/resolvers/zod.
New Drizzle schema src/db/schema/applications.ts defines `applications` table with id (uuid PK), userId (uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, FK → user.id cascade delete), depts (text[] not null), responses (jsonb not null), createdAt + updatedAt (timestamptz). UNIQUE enforced at DB level. Migration generated and applied via `pnpm db:generate` + `pnpm db:migrate`. RLS enabled.
New server module src/lib/actions/applications.ts ('use server') exposes: (a) `submitApplication(input)` — re-validates with Zod, upserts one row per userId via `onConflictDoUpdate`; (b) `getMyApplication()` — returns the current session user's row (or null). Both enforce session presence server-side.
Single unified submission — wizard aggregates dept selections + per-dept responses into one payload, POSTs once via submitApplication, shows success confirmation card on success and a sonner error toast with retry on failure. Upsert semantics allow safe re-submission (no UI for re-submit in this ferment).
Existing /join auth gating preserved client-side (useSession) and server-side (server actions reject unauthenticated callers). Nav "Join MSC" button continues to route to /join (verified, not edited).
Project verification: `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes; `pnpm lint` passes; `pnpm build` succeeds; old hardcoded single-form /join content fully removed (no orphan code); UNIQUE constraint on userId present in generated migration SQL.

phases.answer: Backend: applications table + server actions, Frontend: /join wizard + submitted view

phaseSnapshots.name: Backend: applications table + server actions
phaseSnapshots.goal: Add Drizzle schema for `applications` (UNIQUE on userId), generate+apply migration with RLS, and create server actions `submitApplication` (upsert) and `getMyApplication` (read own row).
phaseSnapshots.description: Add the persistence + read layer first so the frontend wizard has both a target to POST to and a way to detect prior submissions. Localized change in src/db/schema/, src/lib/actions/, and a generated migration.

steps.description: Create src/db/schema/applications.ts: define `applications` table with `pgTable` from drizzle-orm/pg-core — id (uuid PK defaultRandom), userId (uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE with FK references('user','id',{onDelete:'cascade'})), depts (text().array().notNull()), responses (jsonb().$type<Record<DeptId, unknown>>().notNull()), createdAt (timestamp().defaultNow().notNull()), updatedAt (timestamp().defaultNow().notNull().$onUpdate(() => new Date())). Export the inferred row type. The `.unique()` on userId produces a UNIQUE constraint in the generated SQL.

verification.command: pnpm tsc --noEmit (no errors in new schema file)

steps.description: Register the new schema in src/db/schema index (if one exists) or import it where the Drizzle client is constructed. Run `pnpm db:generate` to produce a migration SQL file under drizzle/. Inspect generated SQL — verify it includes CREATE TABLE applications with UNIQUE (userId) and the RLS policy. If RLS is not auto-generated, append manually (e.g. `ALTER TABLE applications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "users manage own" ON applications FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (auth.uid() = "userId") WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = "userId");`).

verification.command: pnpm db:generate produces drizzle/000N_applications.sql containing UNIQUE (userId) and CREATE POLICY lines; tsc clean

steps.description: Run `pnpm db:migrate` (drizzle-kit push) against the configured Supabase DB to apply the migration. Verify by inspecting the live DB or running a quick `SELECT * FROM applications LIMIT 0` query via a test script.

verification.command: pnpm db:migrate exits 0; new `applications` table with UNIQUE(userId) exists in DB

steps.description: Create src/lib/actions/applications.ts ('use server'): export (a) `submitApplication(input: unknown): Promise<{ ok: true; id: string } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — resolves session, re-validates against a server-side ApplicationSchema (defined locally to avoid coupling server to client component), upserts via `db.insert(applications).values({ userId, depts, responses }).onConflictDoUpdate({ target: applications.userId, set: { depts, responses, updatedAt: new Date() } }).returning({ id: applications.id })`; (b) `getMyApplication(): Promise<{ ok: true; application: ApplicationRow } | { ok: true; application: null } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — resolves session, returns the user's row or null. Both throw if no session.
Verification: run `pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build` — all must exit 0. Confirm the new table is registered and migration applied.

verification.command: pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build all exit 0

phaseSnapshots.name: Frontend: /join wizard + submitted view
phaseSnapshots.goal: Replace /join with branching view: existing submission → read-only summary; otherwise → multi-step wizard POSTing to submitApplication.
phaseSnapshots.description: Build the wizard AND the submitted-state summary view at /join, both consuming the server actions from Phase 1. All files localized under src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/.

steps.description: Create src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/schemas.ts: define DeptId union ('creativity'|'activity'|'engineering'|'media'), DEPARTMENTS const with id/label/description/icon for each, per-dept Zod schemas (CreativitySchema, ActivitySchema, EngineeringSchema, MediaSchema) each with ≥2 placeholder fields (e.g. portfolioUrl: z.string().url(), motivation: z.string().min(20)), and a combined ApplicationSchema ({ depts: z.array(z.enum([...])).min(1), responses: z.record(z.enum([...]), z.unknown()) }). Export inferred TS types for each.

Create src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/dept-select-step.tsx ('use client'): controlled checkbox-grid component taking selected: DeptId[] + onChange, renders 4 dept cards (icon + label + description) from DEPARTMENTS, each with a styled checkbox, minimum-1 enforced via parent schema. Visual style mirrors existing /join dept-card pattern.

Create src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/dept-form-step.tsx ('use client'): generic single-dept form component accepting dept: Department, defaultValues, onSubmit, onBack. Uses react-hook-form + zodResolver with the dept's Zod schema. Renders via shadcn Form primitives (FormField/FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormMessage). Submit button advances wizard; Back button returns to dept-select.

Create src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/submitted-view.tsx ('use client'): read-only summary card component accepting application: ApplicationRow. Renders a 'Your Application' header, lists chosen departments as labelled chips, then for each selected dept renders a sub-card with the dept label and a generic key→value definition list (Object.entries(responses[dept])). No edit/withdraw buttons in this ferment. Visual style mirrors the existing /join success card (CheckCircle2 icon + surface card pattern).

Replace src/app/(routes)/(site)/join/page.tsx: rewrite as 'use client' component with branching based on existing application. (1) Preserve useSession auth gate from old page (loading skeleton + sign-in/sign-up CTAs for unauthenticated). (2) On mount and on session resolve, call getMyApplication() from Phase 1. (3) If application exists → render SubmittedView. (4) If application is null → render the wizard shell with step state machine ('select' | 'forms' | 'submitting' | 'done' | 'error'), accumulated state { selectedDepts: DeptId[], responses: Record<DeptId, object>, currentFormIndex: number }. Step 'select' renders DeptSelectStep; step 'forms' iterates selectedDepts rendering DeptFormStep per dept, persisting responses; final submit calls submitApplication({ depts, responses }) — on ok transition to 'done' with success card; on error show sonner toast and re-enable retry. Navbar link untouched.

verification.command: pnpm tsc --noEmit + pnpm lint passes + pnpm build succeeds

steps.description: End-to-end verification: (1) `pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build` all exit 0; (2) old hardcoded form JSX fully removed from page.tsx (grep for "Personal Information" or "Statement of Purpose" returns no hits); (3) navbar 'Join MSC' still routes to /join (visual grep); (4) smoke test documented in .kimchi/docs/smoke.md: (a) submit an application as a mock user → submitted view shows on revisit; (b) call submitApplication twice with the same userId → second call updates rather than errors; (c) getMyApplication returns null for a user with no submission.

verification.command: pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build all exit 0; grep for old form strings returns no hits; smoke checks documented in .kimchi/docs/smoke.md

assumptions.answer: The codebase has react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, drizzle-orm, @supabase/supabase-js, and Better Auth already installed and in active use. shadcn/ui Form primitives (form.tsx) are available. No shadcn checkbox primitive exists in src/components/ui — dept-select uses plain `<input type="checkbox">` styled to match existing /join dept-card style. Departments are typed as a literal union ('creativity' | 'activity' | 'engineering' | 'media') in a single source of truth, matching existing leadership data (HODs exist for Creativity, Activity, Engineering & Innovation, Media). Database shape: one `applications` row per userId with `depts` as text[] and `responses` as jsonb keyed by DeptId. UNIQUE on userId is enforced at DB level and supplemented by server-action upsert (`onConflictDoUpdate`) so re-submissions update the existing row rather than erroring. RLS policy: authenticated users can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE rows where userId matches their session id. Server actions use Better Auth's server-side session helper (pattern in src/lib/auth/server.ts). The submitted view is purely read-only: it lists the chosen depts and renders each dept's responses in a labeled list using a generic key→value definition list (no per-dept typed renderer). No "edit application" or "withdraw application" button is added — re-application is out of scope. The branching fetch (getMyApplication) is called once when /join mounts; while the fetch is in flight the page shows the existing 'Loading...' skeleton (already present in the current /join). If the user is not signed in, the existing auth gate renders sign-in/sign-up CTAs (no fetch attempted). Navbar already links "Join MSC" to /join — no navbar edit needed, only verification. Migration applied via `pnpm db:generate` + `pnpm db:migrate` workflow.

payload.summary: Phase 1 complete: backend plumbing for the application table is in place. Schema (`src/db/schema/applications.ts`) defines `applications` with text IDs, `.enableRLS()`, FK cascade to `user.id`, UNIQUE on `user_id`, JSONB responses, and a text array of dept ids. Migration (`drizzle/0003_cooing_sentinels.sql`) generated and applied to the live Supabase DB with RLS enabled and a manually-appended RESTRICTIVE policy `users manage own applications` TO authenticated using `(select auth.uid())::text = user_id` (the `::text` cast is required because `auth.uid()` returns `uuid` and `user_id` is `text`). Server actions (`src/lib/actions/applications.ts`) expose `submitApplication(input)` (Zod re-validation, upsert via `onConflictDoUpdate`, `revalidatePath("/join")`) and `getMyApplication()` (returns row or null). Both throw `Unauthorized` if no session. Project verify (`pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build`) all exit 0 with the /join route still in the route table (existing client component, slated for replacement in Phase 2).

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
